one_liner: Amazon SP-API is a broad REST API for seller/vendor data with OAuth (Login with Amazon) authorization. It needs developer registration and role approval, and Amazon now publishes an official SP-API MCP connector.
auth_notes: The official MCP connector authorizes via the Seller Central OAuth consent flow. The fetched pages do not detail the LWA refresh-token or AWS signing specifics for the REST API; those come from the earlier draft and general knowledge.
access_notes: The fetched pages show a developer registration process (registration status check, third-party provider registration) and role-limited access. They do not show the Professional-account requirement or role-approval wording, which the draft cited from pages not provided here. App review remains the most defensible value but is not fully confirmed by the supplied text.
blocker_notes: Developer registration and role approval are required before meaningful use. The supplied pages confirm a registration and status-check process and an Appstore listing process, but not the exact requirements.

evidence.quote: Welcome to Selling Partner API Documentation. Learn how to get started and build applications with Amazon's REST-based SP-API.
The bundled `.mcp.json` registers the Amazon Selling Partner Connector (MCP server) at `https://sellingpartner-ai.amazon.com/mcp`.
You authorize access through the standard Seller Central OAuth consent flow; the assistant can only use tools allowed by your Seller Central roles.
